sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in commanding position and will be heavy favourites against a struggling Alsager side occupying 19th place with just 4 points. This is a chance for the leaders to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a clash between two of the division's strongest performers, with Bridgnorth seeking to build on recent wins. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face a midweek fixture against Brereton Social on Wednesday evening after hosting Wednesfield Community on Saturday. Bilston Town travel to Foley Meir on Saturday, with both sides showing decent recent form. Market Drayton Town host New Mills in a mid-table encounter, while Barnton welcome Shawbury United—the latter arriving in the fixture list having lost their last five consecutive matches. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town, a basement-zone clash, and Crewe host Allscott Heath in another lower-table encounter. Brereton Social, currently 14th, host Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) on Saturday before their Wednesday trip to face Wolverhampton Casuals.
